title: Pre-Migration: Add AgentFactory to ServiceContainer
description: Refactor agent instantiation to use dependency injection pattern by creating AgentFactory and registering it in ServiceContainer. This resolves ARCH-001 tight coupling issue where workflow levels directly instantiate agents. Must be completed before TypeScript migration to enable seamless DI framework transition.

criteria: 1 AgentFactory class created in src/agents/factory.py with lazy initialization pattern
AgentFactory registered in ServiceContainer with get_agent() method
5 agent types (Commander, Architect, Writer, Critic, Plot) supported by factory
All agent instantiation uses container.get_agent() instead of direct Agent() calls
74 existing pytest tests pass after refactoring
No functional changes - behavior remains identical
convergence.verification: python -m pytest tests/ -v && grep -r 'AgentFactory' src/container.py src/agents/factory.py | wc -l >= 2
convergence.definition_of_done: Agent instantiation fully decoupled via DI, enabling TypeScript DI framework migration
